description: Source code for the 'git push' command implementation, including functions for handling push refspecs, configuration, and transport.

methods.name: refspec_append_mapped
methods.description: Appends a refspec mapping for a remote branch, considering push defaults and branch tracking.

methods.name: set_refspecs
methods.description: Sets refspecs based on provided references, handling tags, deletions, and mappings.

methods.name: die_push_simple
methods.description: Handles error when the upstream branch does not match the current branch, providing guidance.

methods.name: get_upstream_ref
methods.description: Determines the upstream reference for a branch, considering push flags and branch state.

methods.name: setup_default_push_refspecs
methods.description: Configures default refspecs for push based on push.default setting and branch state.

methods.name: advise_pull_before_push
methods.description: Provides advice to pull before pushing if remote is behind.

methods.name: advise_checkout_pull_push
methods.description: Provides advice to pull before pushing if local branch is behind remote.

methods.name: advise_ref_already_exists
methods.description: Provides advice if the remote ref already exists.

methods.name: advise_ref_fetch_first
methods.description: Provides advice to fetch first if remote contains work not in local.

methods.name: advise_ref_needs_force
methods.description: Provides advice if force is needed to update remote ref.

methods.name: advise_ref_needs_update
methods.description: Provides advice if remote ref has been updated since last fetch.

methods.name: push_with_options
methods.description: Performs push operation with specified options, handling errors and rejection reasons.

methods.name: do_push
methods.description: Executes the push process for all configured remotes and refspecs.
